UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Filters entities by the specified UTC update interval. The end of the interval must be no later than 5 minutes in the past. The maximum interval is 180 days.

LedgerEntryFilters.title: Export ledger entry data filters
LedgerEntryFilters.description: Filters specific to the `LedgerEntry` entity type. Required when `EntityType` is `LedgerEntry`.
